editorial.blurb: Authentic Korean BBQ on Glenview's second floor where gopchang (grilled intestines) and galbi shine, backed by exceptional service and a spotless, modern space with outstanding ventilation.
editorial.insiderTip: Order the Everyday Special Set to sample multiple proteins and sides; arrive for weekday lunch if you want a quieter experience, but note there may be limited staff—the owner's personal attention at dinner more than makes up for any wait.
